Coram : S.H. KAPADIA*, D.K. JAIN, S.S. NIJJAR, J.S. KHEHAR, RANJANA PRAKASH DESAI
448 A STATE OF KERALA & ORS. B v. M/S. MAR APPRAEM KURI CO. LTD. & ANR. (Civil Appeal No. 6660 of 2005) MAY 08, 2012 [S.H.KAPADIA, CJI., D.K. JAIN, SURINDER SINGH NIJJAR, RANJANA PRAKASH DESAI AND JAGDISH SINGH KHEHAR, JJ.) c Constitution of India, 1950 - Article 254 (1) and Seventh the Central Act was enforced in that State - Held: 0 Repugnancy arises on the making of the law i.e. when the Central Act received the assent of the President and not on its commencement/enforcement - The Central Law though not brought in force in that State, is still a law made, which is alive
Decision Date : 08-05-2012 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6660/2005 | Disposal Nature : Reference answered | Bench : 5 Judges
